articles.expand: Bullock's Q A comments read as a clear extension of her earlier committee testimony , where she said upside inflation risks flagged in August are now materialising, and they push the tone further toward a hike at the September 28-29 meeting . articles.title: Preview: BoJ rate hike bet stays intact as Japan awaits August CPI
articles.expand: Japan's inflation data typically carries limited standalone weight on the yen and JGB yields when a Bank of Japan decision lands the same day, and today looks no different. Traders are more focused on the outcome of the BoJ meeting and Governor Ueda's press conference this afternoon than on the CPI print itself, given a rate hike is already close to fully priced by swap markets. A core reading in line with the 1.8% consensus would likely do little to alter that path, while a surprise miss or beat could still nudge USD/JPY and short-dated JGB yields in the hours before the policy announcement. ...

articles.title: The Riksbank’s Business Survey: “There was some concern before the summer, but then things took a turn for the better”
articles.expand: The economic situation has improved since last spring and, for the first time since September 2022, large Swedish companies’ assessment of the situation is now above its historical average. Before the summer, there were fears that the war in the Middle East would delay the recovery, but those fears have not materialised. Demand has strengthened and the cost increases resulting from the war are considered to be manageable. As a result, companies are taking a more optimistic view of future developments. This is revealed by the Riksbank’s Business Survey in August.
